limitations: Actual individual bristle geometry with real spaces: 182 radial tufts, two filaments per tuft (364 total). All LODs retain the filaments while reducing their cross-section, core and hook tessellation. No opaque spherical brush-head envelope or photo texture.

Each tuft root is captured inside the rounded core; stem, grip and open hanging hook have fixed overlapping joints. This is a static visual assembly, not flexible bristle simulation or a measured brush mounting.
Own approximate full length: 39 cm. Hidden rear, core, mounting, bristle count and exact dimensions are generalized from one source view. No cleaning-performance, real-material or safety claims.
Actual unlabeled 128px renders reviewed: radial fine strands and hooked handle read as a cleaning brush rather than a solid ball or club. Assistant judgment only, not an audience test.
Three decreasing LODs in BLEND, GLB and FBX. Actual reimport renders checked; no Unity, runtime, animation or cleaning-function certification.
Valid overlapping per-face planar UVs are provided, not a unique packed bake atlas. Plain materials require no external images.
Private BOSS published reference has unverified photographer/manufacturer and redistribution rights. No reference photo, logo, branding or copied image texture supplied.
